strings.dialog.signIn.clipboardFound: Picked up the request you copied. Sign in when you're ready.
strings.dialog.signIn.closeWindow: When you're done, close the private window without signing out: signing out there signs Rambutan out too.
strings.dialog.signIn.error.noSignIn: That doesn't include a YouTube sign-in (there's no SAPISID cookie in it). Copy a request from music.youtube.com while you're signed in, as in step 3.
strings.dialog.signIn.error.googleInFirstBox: That's the accounts.google.com request. Paste it in the box under “Stay signed in”, and copy a music.youtube.com request into this one, as in step 3.
strings.dialog.signIn.error.noGoogleSignIn: That doesn't include a Google sign-in (there's no LSID cookie in it). Copy the first request to accounts.google.com, not to myaccount.google.com or music.youtube.com, or leave this box empty.
strings.dialog.signIn.error.rejected: YouTube Music didn't accept these cookies. They may come from a signed-out tab or have expired: reload music.youtube.com, check you're signed in, and copy a fresh request.
strings.dialog.signIn.error.unreachable: Couldn't reach YouTube Music to check these cookies. Check your connection, then try again.
strings.dialog.signIn.heading: Sign in with your browser's cookies
strings.dialog.signIn.intro: Rambutan needs its own YouTube sign-in, made in a private browser window. Sharing your everyday browser's sign-in can sign that browser out, because both keep refreshing it. Copy the sign-in once from the developer tools:
strings.dialog.signIn.placeholder: curl 'https://music.youtube.com/…' -b '…'   (the Cookie header value on its own works too)
strings.dialog.signIn.renew.clipboardFound: Picked up the accounts.google.com request you copied.
strings.dialog.signIn.renew.heading: Optional: stay signed in
strings.dialog.signIn.renew.intro: YouTube stops accepting a copied sign-in a day or two after Rambutan last ran. With the accounts.google.com cookies too, Rambutan renews it by itself, as a browser does. These cookies give access to your whole Google account, not only YouTube. Rambutan sends them only to accounts.google.com.
strings.dialog.signIn.renew.placeholder: curl 'https://accounts.google.com/' -b '…'   (leave empty to sign in without it)
strings.dialog.signIn.renew.plain: With no system keyring running, these are stored unencrypted too, like your YouTube cookies.
strings.dialog.signIn.renew.step: Before you close the private window, go to accounts.google.com in it. Clear the filter box, then copy the first request in the list, accounts.google.com (not myaccount.google.com), as cURL, the same way as in step 3.
strings.dialog.signIn.step1: Open a private window (Ctrl+Shift+N; Firefox: Ctrl+Shift+P), go to music.youtube.com and sign in.
strings.dialog.signIn.step2: Press F12 to open the developer tools, choose the Network tab, and reload the page.
strings.dialog.signIn.step3After: in the filter box, right-click the first request, and copy it as cURL:
strings.dialog.signIn.step4: Come back here. Rambutan picks the copy up from the clipboard, or you can paste it below.

strings.settings.appearance.ambient: Tint the app with the album art
strings.settings.appearance.ambientHelp: Blurs the artwork of whatever is playing behind the whole window. Turn it off for a flat dark background.
strings.settings.appearance.artworkMeter: Show a meter on the album art
strings.settings.appearance.artworkMeterHelp: Small bars over the player bar's artwork move with the music while a track plays. Reduced motion hides them either way.
strings.settings.appearance.visualizerStyleHelp: How the Now Playing visualizer draws. Radial draws around the artwork; while the lyrics are open, the visualizer fills the pane, or a track has no artwork, it shows bars. The meter on the player bar is always bars.
strings.settings.appearance.visualizerAdvancedHe: Adds the feedback loop, plasma, tunnel and kaleidoscope to the visualizer styles. They move all the time while music plays, so they use more of the processor and the graphics card than the other styles. Reduced motion stops them.
strings.settings.appearance.visualizerCycleHelp: Picks another of the styles above, the presets too while they're on. The style you chose comes back when you turn this off.
strings.settings.appearance.accentHelp: The color of buttons, switches, the playing track and other highlights, here and on the phone remote. From the artwork follows each track's cover. Very dark colors are lightened so they stay readable.
strings.settings.appearance.accent.invalid: Not a color. Use #RGB or #RRGGBB. The app keeps the last valid one.
strings.settings.appearance.visualizerColorHelp: The color the Now Playing visualizer draws in. From the artwork picks the strongest color of each track's cover.
strings.settings.appearance.visualizerColor.inva: Not a color. Use #RGB or #RRGGBB. The visualizer keeps the last valid one.
strings.settings.appearance.visualizerFrameRateH: How often the meter and the Now Playing visualizer redraw. A higher rate moves more smoothly and uses more of the graphics card. Reduced motion stops both either way.
strings.settings.appearance.motionNoteFull: Your system doesn't ask for reduced motion. Choose Reduce to keep Rambutan still anyway: no fades, no sliding toasts, no pulsing placeholders, and the visualizer pauses.
strings.settings.appearance.motionNoteReduced: Your system asks for reduced motion, so Rambutan keeps still: no fades, no sliding toasts, no pulsing placeholders, and the visualizer pauses.
strings.settings.behavior.closeToTray: Closing the window keeps Rambutan running in the tray
strings.settings.behavior.noTray: This desktop shows no tray icons, so closing the window minimizes it instead.
strings.settings.behavior.taskbarControlsHelp: Previous, play or pause, next, like and shuffle under the window's taskbar preview, and the track's progress on its taskbar button.
strings.settings.discord.enabled: Show what I'm listening to on Discord
strings.settings.discord.ownClock: Without the elapsed and remaining time, Discord shows its own clock, which counts up from when the activity appeared.
strings.settings.discord.share.artwork: a link to its artwork on YouTube Music's image servers
strings.settings.discord.share.elapsed: when it started and when it ends
strings.settings.discord.share.nothing: only that you're listening to something
strings.settings.discord.share.track: the track's title, artist and album
strings.settings.discord.sharingNote: Sent to the Discord app on this computer: {what}. Discord shows it as "Listening to Rambutan" to people who can see your activity, and clears it when playback pauses or stops.
strings.settings.discord.status.off: Off. Nothing is sent to Discord.
strings.settings.discord.status.refused: Discord refused the connection ({reason}). Rambutan keeps trying every minute.
strings.settings.discord.status.refusedNoReason: Discord refused the connection. Rambutan keeps trying every minute.
strings.settings.discord.status.waiting: Waiting for Discord. Rambutan connects on its own when the Discord app is running on this computer.
strings.settings.discord.unavailable: Discord isn't available in this build: it was built without a Discord application id.
strings.settings.downloads.exportFormat.mp3: MP3 (re-encoded, so some quality is lost)
strings.settings.downloads.exportFormatHelp: Original quality copies the downloaded audio as it is. MP3 is for players that can't open .ogg or .m4a.
strings.settings.downloads.exportHelp: Adds Export to the downloads in Library, On this computer, to save them as ordinary audio files with their title, artist, album, cover and YouTube Music song. Exported files are yours: removing a download leaves them.
strings.settings.downloads.folderHelp: New downloads go here. Changing the folder leaves existing downloads where they are, and they keep playing.
strings.settings.downloads.folderNotWritable: Rambutan can't write to that folder. Choose another one.
strings.settings.downloads.usageHelp: Downloads aren't part of the disk cache, and its size limit doesn't remove them.
strings.settings.equalizer.help: Shapes the sound with ten bands, from 31 Hz to 16 kHz, each up to 12 dB up or down. A boost lowers the overall level by as much, so the sound doesn't distort.
strings.settings.equalizer.resetTip: Set every band back to 0 dB
strings.settings.equalizer.title: Equalizer
strings.settings.language.help: Most text changes right away. Messages already on screen, such as notifications and load errors, change the next time they appear.
strings.settings.language.label: Display language
strings.settings.lastfm.approveHint: After approving Rambutan on the Last.fm page, come back and choose Finish connecting.
strings.settings.lastfm.browserFailed: Couldn't open the browser. Open the address below to approve Rambutan.
strings.settings.lastfm.disclosure: While connected, Rambutan sends Last.fm the artist, title, album and length of each track you play: once as "now playing" when it starts, and once as a scrobble with the time it started, after you've listened to half of it or 4 minutes. Tracks of 30 seconds or less aren't sent. Nothing else is shared.
strings.settings.lastfm.notice.approvalExpired: That approval link expired. Choose Connect to start again.
strings.settings.lastfm.notice.connectKeyRefused: Last.fm refused this build's API key, so connecting can't work in this build.
strings.settings.lastfm.notice.connectRateLimite: Last.fm is limiting requests right now. Try again in a few minutes.
strings.settings.lastfm.notice.connectRefused: Last.fm refused the request. Try connecting again.
strings.settings.lastfm.notice.connectUnreachabl: Couldn't reach Last.fm. Check your connection and try again.
strings.settings.lastfm.notice.keyRefused: Last.fm refused this build's API key. Scrobbles are kept until a build that works can send them.
strings.settings.lastfm.notice.notApprovedYet: Last.fm hasn't seen your approval yet. Approve Rambutan in the browser, then choose Finish again.
strings.settings.lastfm.notice.sessionEnded: Last.fm ended this connection. Rambutan still records what you play, and sends it when you connect again. Disconnect discards it.
strings.settings.lastfm.notice.slowedDown: Last.fm asked Rambutan to slow down. Scrobbles are kept and sent later.
strings.settings.lastfm.notice.unreachable: Couldn't reach Last.fm. Scrobbles are kept and sent when it's back.
strings.settings.lastfm.pending: {count, plural, one {# scrobble is waiting to be sent.} other {# scrobbles are waiting to be sent.}}
strings.settings.lastfm.pendingConnected: {count, plural, one {# scrobble is waiting to be sent. Disconnecting discards them.} other {# scrobbles are waiting to be sent. Disconnecting discards them.}}
strings.settings.lastfm.stations: Use Last.fm stations on Home and on artist pages
strings.settings.lastfm.stations.disclosure: Rambutan sends your Last.fm username to last.fm to get your lists, and an artist's name when you open their station. It then searches YouTube Music for each track in a list, signed out, so the searches stay out of your YouTube history. Tracks that YouTube Music doesn't have play from the YouTube link Last.fm gives.
strings.settings.lastfm.stations.needsAccount: Connect a Last.fm account to use this.
strings.settings.lastfm.status.awaiting: Waiting for you to approve Rambutan in the browser…
strings.settings.lastfm.unavailable: Last.fm isn't available in this build: it was built without a Last.fm API key.
strings.settings.local.foldersHelp: Rambutan reads the music files in these folders: their tags, length and cover. It notices changes while it runs, and looks for changes at each start and when you rescan.
strings.settings.local.match: Find my music files on YouTube Music
strings.settings.local.matchHelp: When you play a song from this computer, or open its menu, its artist and title are sent to YouTube Music's search, without your account. Nothing else about the file leaves this computer. A song found there gives the file a radio for autoplay, likes and playlists, and the cover, artist or album its tags lack. A file Rambutan exported names its song itself: it has the song with this setting off too, and is never searched.
strings.settings.local.notWatched: Rambutan can't watch this folder for changes now. It finds them at the next start or when you rescan.
strings.settings.local.unavailable: Not available now. Its files keep their last state until it is back.
strings.settings.local.statusFiles: {count, plural, one {# music file} other {# music files}}
strings.settings.local.statusUnreadable: {count, plural, one {# file couldn't be read as music.} other {# files couldn't be read as music.}}
strings.settings.local.statusMissing: {count, plural, one {# file is missing.} other {# files are missing.}}
strings.settings.lyrics.onlineHelp: Finds lyrics on LRCLIB for tracks that have none of your own. Each lookup sends the track's title, artist, album and length to lrclib.net. Off, only your own lyrics and ones already found are shown.
strings.settings.overlay.clients: {count, plural, =0 {OBS isn't showing the overlay yet.} one {# overlay page is connected.} other {# overlay pages are connected.}}
strings.settings.overlay.copied: URL copied. It includes the overlay key: paste it into OBS, not into chat.
strings.settings.overlay.disclosure: While this is on, Rambutan serves the overlay to programs on this computer only; other devices can't reach it, and nothing is sent off this computer. The URL includes a key that lets a program see what's playing, its cover and the visualizer, but not control playback. OBS keeps the URL in its scene collections, so if you share one, reset the URL.
strings.settings.overlay.editor.color.help: Hex colors: #RGB, #RRGGBB, or with opacity last, #RGBA or #RRGGBBAA (00 is clear, FF is solid).
strings.settings.overlay.editor.color.invalid: Not a hex color. The overlay keeps the last valid one.
strings.settings.overlay.editor.discard: Discard your changes to the overlay style? Open overlays go back to the saved style.
strings.settings.overlay.editor.hint: Changes show in the preview and in open overlays at once. Save keeps them; Close without saving puts the saved style back.
strings.settings.overlay.editor.preview.hidden: Empty: the overlay shows nothing until a track plays.
strings.settings.overlay.editor.preview.playing: The preview shows what's playing now, at a still position.
strings.settings.overlay.editor.preview.sample: Nothing is playing, so the preview shows a sample track with still bars.
strings.settings.overlay.editor.preview.still: Reduce motion is on, so the preview's bars stand still. The overlay leaves its bars out when the system asks for reduced motion.
strings.settings.overlay.editor.sample.title: Track title
strings.settings.overlay.editor.status.liveSaved: Open overlays show this style. It is saved.
strings.settings.overlay.editor.status.liveUnsav: Open overlays show these changes now. They aren't saved yet.
strings.settings.overlay.editor.status.offSaved: The overlay is off, so only the preview shows this style. It is saved.
strings.settings.overlay.editor.status.offUnsave: The overlay is off, so only the preview shows these changes. They aren't saved yet.
strings.settings.overlay.editor.title: Overlay style
strings.settings.overlay.howTo: In OBS, add a Browser source, paste the copied URL, and set its size to 600 × 200. The page is transparent around the card. It shows the track, its cover, its progress and visualizer bars; when the system asks for reduced motion, it leaves the bars out.
strings.settings.overlay.portBusy: Another program is using port {usual}, so the overlay uses port {port} for now. Copy the URL again and paste it into OBS.
strings.settings.overlay.resetDone: New URL made. The old one no longer works; copy the new one into OBS.
strings.settings.overlay.status.failed: Couldn't start the overlay. The log has the details.
strings.settings.overlay.status.listening: On. The overlay is available to programs on this computer.
strings.settings.overlay.status.off: Off. Rambutan doesn't serve the overlay.
strings.settings.overlay.status.portInUse: Couldn't start: another program is using the overlay's port.
strings.settings.overlay.style.custom: The overlay uses your own style.
strings.settings.overlay.style.default: The overlay uses the default style.
strings.settings.overlay.style.help: Edit the overlay's colors, size and parts with a live preview. A style is a small JSON file: export it to share it, and import one someone shared. Open overlays change at once.
strings.settings.overlay.style.imported: Style imported. Open overlays use it now.
strings.settings.overlay.style.ioFailed: Couldn't read or write the style file.
strings.settings.overlay.style.newer: That style was made by a newer version of Rambutan. Update Rambutan to use it.
strings.settings.overlay.style.notAStyle: That file isn't a Rambutan overlay style.
strings.settings.overlay.style.notJson: That file isn't a Rambutan overlay style: it isn't valid JSON.
strings.settings.overlay.style.resetDone: The overlay uses the default style again.
strings.settings.overlay.style.savedNewer: Your saved style was made by a newer version of Rambutan, so the overlay uses the default style.
strings.settings.overlay.style.savedUnreadable: Your saved style couldn't be read, so the overlay uses the default style.
strings.settings.overlay.style.tooLarge: That file is too large to be a Rambutan overlay style.
strings.settings.playback.autoplay: Autoplay similar songs when the queue ends
strings.settings.playback.autoplayHelp: Continues with a radio based on the last track, preferring songs you haven't heard this session. Repeat takes precedence while it's on.
strings.settings.playback.cacheHelp: Fully played tracks are kept on disk and replay without the network. 0 turns the cache off and clears it.
strings.settings.playback.fadeOnSkipHelp: Skips fade briefly into the next track instead of cutting. Fades never run longer than 2 seconds on a skip.
strings.settings.playback.normalizeHelp: Turns loud tracks down to a common level using YouTube Music's loudness data. Takes effect from the next track.
strings.settings.playback.outputHelp: System default plays through the device your system uses, and moves when you change it there. A device you choose is used while it's connected; while it isn't, playback uses the system default.
strings.settings.playback.qualityHelp: High streams Opus at about 130–160 kbps; Data saver at about 50 kbps. Applies to tracks loaded after the change; tracks already in the disk cache play as they were saved.
strings.settings.remote.addressHelp: This computer is on more than one network. If your phone can't open the page, pick another address; the code and link change with it.
strings.settings.remote.clients: {count, plural, =0 {No phone is connected.} one {# phone is connected.} other {# phones are connected.}}
strings.settings.remote.copied: Link copied. It includes the pairing key, so share it only with your own devices.
strings.settings.remote.disclosure: While this is on, Rambutan listens on your local network. Anyone on the network can open the remote's page, but only a phone you pair with the code shown here can see what's playing and the queue, and control them: play, pause, skip, seek, volume, jump to, move or remove queued songs, and search YouTube Music to add songs. Its searches go through this computer, signed in as you are here. The connection is plain HTTP, not encrypted, so use the remote only on networks you trust. Your firewall may ask whether to let Rambutan use the network.
strings.settings.remote.portBusy: Another program is using port {usual}, so the remote uses port {port} for now. Phones paired on port {usual} need to scan the code again.
strings.settings.remote.resetDone: Pairing reset. Phones paired before are disconnected and must scan the new code.
strings.settings.remote.scan: Scan the code with your phone's camera, or open the copied link on it. The phone must be on the same network as this computer.
strings.settings.remote.status.failed: Couldn't start the remote. The log has the details.
strings.settings.remote.status.listening: On. Rambutan is listening on your local network.
strings.settings.remote.status.noNetwork: On, but this computer isn't connected to a network. Connect it to the same network as your phone.
strings.settings.remote.status.off: Off. Rambutan doesn't listen on the network.
strings.settings.remote.status.portInUse: Couldn't start: another program is using the network port.
strings.settings.remote.status.refused: Couldn't start: the system didn't let Rambutan listen on the network.

strings.shortcuts.moveQueueTrack: Move the selected queue track (or drag it)
strings.shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
strings.signIn.storage.encrypted: Cookies are stored encrypted on this device (Windows data protection) and only sent to YouTube and Google.
strings.signIn.storage.keyring: Cookies are stored in your system keyring and only sent to YouTube and Google.
strings.signIn.storage.looking: Checking whether a system keyring is running, to know where to keep your cookies…
strings.signIn.storage.plain: No system keyring is running, so Rambutan stores your cookies unencrypted, in files that only your user account can read. Anyone who can use your account or read your home folder can copy them and use your YouTube account, or your whole Google account if you add the Google sign-in below. Rambutan sends them only to YouTube and Google. To have them encrypted, start a keyring (GNOME Keyring or KWallet, for example) and then restart Rambutan.
